name: Oil pump assembly
what: The oil pump draws oil from the sump and pressurizes it so oil can circulate through the engine.
why: A steady supply of pressurized oil lubricates the crankshaft bearings and other moving parts.
where: In this simulator, the pump is mounted at the opposite longitudinal end of the block, around the crankshaft axis beside the short protruding end feature.
installationReason: Install the rotating assembly first. The pump mounts at the opposite end of the engine block, concentric with the crankshaft axis.
